| | | Donald Trump is losing it, and increasingly showing signs of dementia. And anyone who has watched or read his rambling speeches can see that. He forgets where he is. He mixes up people. He seems to think he's still running against Biden, etc. **But you wouldn't know that from most mainstream-media sources, which have been "[sane-washing](https://default.salsalabs.org/T89ce3864-5f79-4f0e-a058-d82fcf99d2c0/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)" Trump's speeches, and turning deranged stream of consciousness rambling about how "child care [is child care](https://default.salsalabs.org/Ta2a27964-0df8-4d6e-9177-4dedc6fc0b35/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)" into seemingly sane headlines like "Trump discusses plan for child care."** We get it. No one is comfortable that the guy with a coin-flip chance of being president has lost his mind (what little he had left). But reporters need to stop normalizing Trump's behavior, and admit there is a big, big problem. subject: Early Voting in Arizona starts in about four weeks. Yeesh.

body:
#

In Arizona, early in-person voting begins 27 days before Election Day.
That means voters start heading to the polls in about four weeks. Folks start getting their mail-in ballots before that.
As hard to believe as all of that is, time is running out.
We’re losing runway. Fast.

body:
...and why Josh Hawley could never understand that Missouri
#
Peter — Josh Hawley could never understand the Missouri I grew up in.
**Please let me explain:**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/70827?refcode=em20240907-7578&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=7578%2E614464%2E7fknXS)
On the right is Joshua Hawley. While his banker daddy was sending him to a fancy prep school miles from his hometown, my family and I were relying on our neighbors to survive bankruptcy and medical bills in mid-Missouri — in a community where people took care of each other. That’s us on the left.
When Hawley graduated from law school, he joined one of the world’s most elite corporate law firms. I joined the Marine Corps to pay back the community in Missouri that took care of me and my family. And when he was climbing the ladder to become another corrupt politician, I was serving my country — and then working to prevent the pointless overseas wars that make us less safe.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/70827?refcode=em20240907-7578&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=7578%2E614464%2E7fknXS)
While Josh Hawley aligned himself with the same giant corporations who’ve spent decades attacking Missouri workers and shipping away our jobs, I’ve been fighting to take back power for American workers and small businesses.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/70827?refcode=em20240907-7578&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=7578%2E614464%2E7fknXS)
And when Hawley voted against relief for veterans like me who were exposed to toxic burn pits, I stood up alongside thousands of veterans to hold him accountable.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/70827?refcode=em20240907-7578&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=7578%2E614464%2E7fknXS)
**The Missouri I grew up in taught us to take care of one another.** To do your duty. To serve and sacrifice for your fellow Missourians.
**Josh Hawley doesn’t know that Missouri — and on January 6th, 2021, he showed us the only thing he’s learned is how to be a fraud and a coward.**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/70827?refcode=em20240907-7578&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=5&akid=7578%2E614464%2E7fknXS)

| Peter,

I was born to a single mother in High Point, North Carolina, where she instilled in me the values of hard work, integrity, and service to others. Her strength pushed me to become an educator at Bennett College for 4 decades!
---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92349169/496820050/-1824609181?refcode=BLU_EM_ALMA_2024-09-07_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzEzMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0YjcwYzU3Ny0yMTZkLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=O7Da-lqo25cZSBoRcjJgVtcWbNdejEUGZN3-DXdLnEw=)

Throughout my career, I have advocated for the betterment of my community. From being arrested for protesting the overturn of _Roe v. Wade_ to passing the **FUTURE Act** , which permanently provides $255 million a year for all Minority-Serving Institutions, I will always be on the people's side.

I am working to address the **4 Hs** —housing, hunger, healthcare, and higher education—because I know firsthand how difficult it is to struggle without necessary essentials, and nobody deserves that.

name: Ruben Gallego
subject: The American Dream is alive
body:
This is a picture of my mom and my three sisters watching me speak at the DNC. My immigrant mother raised the four of us on a secretary’s salary.
The American Dream is alive, my friends. Just look: This is a picture of my mom and my three sisters watching me speak at the DNC. My immigrant mother raised the four of us on a secretary’s salary. I worked any job I could get to support the family. I slept on the floor, on the couch, on a roll-out mattress. I got into Harvard with no money, no connections. I fought in Iraq. And now, I’m running for the U.S. Senate in Arizona. I believed it when I was a kid, and I believe it now: **Anything is possible in the United States of America.** But there is no denying that the American Dream feels out of reach for far too many. Kari Lake won’t fix that, and Trump won’t either. They’ll divide us further, cut taxes for their billionaire friends, and leave an economy that works for them — not working families, not the middle class. It is up to us to keep the American Dream alive — to defend it, to strengthen it. And the best way we can do that right now is by defeating Trump and Kari Lake. [**So, I’m asking you to make a split donation to my campaign and Wes Moore today. Whatever you can afford. And now, I’m running for the U.S. Senate in Arizona. I believed it when I was a kid, and I believe it now: Anything is possible in the United States of America. But there is no denying that the American Dream feels out of reach for far too many. Kari Lake won’t fix that, and Trump won’t either. They’ll divide us further, cut taxes for their billionaire friends, and leave an economy that works for them — not working families, not the middle class. It is up to us to keep the American Dream alive — to defend it, to strengthen it. And the best way we can do that right now is by defeating Trump and Kari Lake. = | If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation will go through immediately: | | = = | = = | = = Means the world to me that you’ve got my back. Peter, Fasten your seat belts! This coming Tuesday, September 10, Vice President Kamala Harris and former President Donald Trump will go toe-to-toe in a live debate hosted by ABC.

Recent Presidential debates haven't always mattered as much as this one will since by the time the debates take place both candidates have had plenty of opportunity to introduce themselves to the country. But as we recently saw when Donald Trump faced off against President Biden, debates can – and DO – shake the Earth. That single debate triggered one of the wildest periods of political upheaval I've seen in my lifetime.

Anyone who knows what they're talking about will tell you that this race between Trump and Harris is going to be very, very close. Predictions say that the vast majority of Americans have already made up their minds and the outcome will likely be decided by a small fraction of the voting public in a handful of states like Pennsylvania, Michigan and Wisconsin.

But that makes the stakes particularly high for this upcoming debate, because most voters haven't yet had a chance to hear Vice President Harris' vision for America's future. Undecided voters may finally fall off the fence, while even those firmly in one candidate’s camp could find reasons to switch to the other.

It’s important to understand that winning a presidential debate also means winning the news-media cycle that follows the event. Was the candidate prepared? Did the candidate have a vision? Did the candidate effectively contrast themself with their opponent? These are some of the questions that matter, and to "win" the debate each candidate will have to employ a different strategy.

For Vice President Harris, what's critical is that she demonstrates to the American people that she's got the right stuff to lead the nation. Essential to that is projecting confidence and an understanding of the way government works to serve people, and what the limitations of that power are. She should demonstrate that she isn't tied to Biden's entire legacy and that she, in fact, has her own ideas. And she needs to continue to demonstrate that while the economy may be doing well at the moment, too many American families are struggling with higher prices and need help.

For President Trump, what's critical is that he is able to draw a contrast between the Biden/Harris economic record and the record he built during his own time in office. He will also need to challenge Harris' preparedness to do the job as well as demonstrate that he has a plan to accomplish all the things he’s been promising on the campaign trail. And I’m waiting to see if he can restrain some of his worst impulses and stay on message.

Some people may say this election hinges on immigration or foreign affairs or environmental policy. But it's my belief that the final result will actually come down to this simple question: how will your family's finances fare under the next President? Whichever candidate can best address that issue will be elected.

Stay tuned for more thoughts and reactions as we progress into the final stretch of this election. It's hard to believe, but in some states, early in-person or absentee voting for the November 5 election begins this month. Buckle up for a wild ride to the finish!

body:
Tim Walz is a responsible gun owner who understands the importance of gun violence prevention
#

Friends -
Over the years, Governor Tim Walz has had an evolution in his stance on guns and gun violence. As a kid growing up in rural Nebraska, he thought of guns as tools for hunting, not destructive weapons that could be used in a mass shooting. Governor Walz would often go hunting with friends after school.
When Tim Walz was first elected to Congress in 2007 to represent a deep red district in Minnesota, he had an A rating from the NRA. The organization also endorsed and donated to his congressional campaigns.
But Walz had a change of heart after a mass shooter at the Route 91 Harvest Music Festival in Las Vegas took the lives of 60 individuals and injured over 860 more. Faced with the realities of gun violence, Walz announced that he would donate the $18,000 that he had received from the NRA to charity. "I’ll take my kick in the butt from the NRA," he said, and pledged to refuse NRA contributions going forward. He’s kept that promise.
**Today, Tim Walz gets straight F’s from the NRA—a fact that he’s very proud of.**
Then, after the shooting at Marjory Stoneman Douglas High School in 2018, his daughter asked him to do more to stop gun violence. From then on, Walz has taken transformative action on gun violence. This is not a story you'll read about in much of legacy media, but it is a critical story that impacts countless people globally. This is also a deeply personal article because it addresses my birth nation, Pakistan, and my faith as a Muslim who belongs to the Ahmadiyya Muslim Community. This is not an article about evangelism, but about universal freedom of conscience--or the lack thereof.

Ahmadi Muslim women in front of a mosque
While founded as a nation committed to religious freedom and pluralism, Pakistan betrayed its founding principles 50 years ago on September 7, 1974. On that day, Pakistan enacted religious apartheid against the [Ahmadiyya Muslim Community](https://substack.com/redirect/beba995e-0d9b-4b85-91d8-ed22b3a63ac9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). This horrid decision has since metastasized as a cancer that has suffocated Pakistan's growth, potential, and once promising future.

## A brief history of the Ahmadiyya Muslim Community
Founded by a man named [Mirza Ghulam Ahmad](https://substack.com/redirect/8a020ab0-cbdf-4f7e-b664-15d0505b0e08?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in 1889 in a small village known as Qadian, in India, the [Ahmadiyya Muslim Community](https://substack.com/redirect/2bdb7710-eb83-4b8d-adaf-a94d235eeccb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) now spans more than 200 nations globally with tens of millions of adherents. It is the oldest organized Muslim community in the United States, establishing the first and longest running mosque, Al Sadiq mosque, on the south side of Chicago in 1921. This historic mosque raged against Jim Crow America and invited Black, Latino, Indigenous, and white Americans to worship and break bread together, even performing interracial marriages--which were criminal at the time.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e8a2b793-67ed-4392-8825-3e94827073d6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Established in 1921, the historic Al Sadiq Mosque at 4448 S. Wabash in Chicago, IL
Pakistan's first foreign minister, Sir Muhammad Zafrullah Khan, was an Ahmadi Muslim. [He was also a champion of Palestinian rights](https://substack.com/redirect/6dca1bd4-e9ae-4b23-a894-32b402b96524?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). He has tragically been erased from Pakistan's history books.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/66fef8ee-856d-448f-be89-837b8a7e0161?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Sir Muhammad Zafrullah Khan (right) serving as President of UN General Assembly
Pakistan's first Nobel Laureate was renowned physicist Dr. Abdus Salam, an Ahmadi Muslim. He has likewise been all but erased from Pakistan's memory.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/8e34d312-5145-4ce0-9fcb-1eef23134ea6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Dr. Abdus Salam was awarded the Nobel Prize in Physics in 1979 for his contribution to the electroweak unification theory
Ahmadi Muslims in Pakistan are expected to disappear, and I do not say that as a figure of speech. After his death and burial, the Pakistani government desecrated Dr. Salam's grace because it dared to identify Dr. Salam as a Muslim.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c021a002-0d48-4d35-97fa-3e4ed2da89fd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Nobel Laureate Dr. Abdus Salam's desecrated gravestone in Rabwah, Pakistan
By any objective measure, Ahmadi Muslims are peaceful, law abiding citizens in Pakistan and indeed in every country in which they reside. So what went wrong? Due to nothing more than private theological differences, right wing extremists launched a full scale and violent hate campaign against Ahmadi Muslims. Unwilling and unable to meet Ahmadi Muslims in the field of intellectual debate, ignorant clerics globally have turned to punitive punishments to silence dialogue and kill those who dare speak up.

## The persecution becomes state sanctioned
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/45a2d537-8d5f-4dfb-8054-4150d1a2ce0f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Remains of a mosque built by the Ahmadiyya Muslim Community, destroyed by hardline extremists in Pakistan
Ahmadi Muslims have long suffered hate and bigotry from hardline extremists who insist on enacting violence and terrorism. But this violence elevated to a new level in Pakistan on September 7, 2024. This date marks fifty years of apartheid in Pakistan. On September 7, 1974, Pakistan passed the Second Amendment to its Constitution, which declared the Ahmadiyya Muslim Community as "non-Muslim" under the law. You might be wondering what right a government has to dictate a person's personal faith? The answer is, no government has this right, and this is why we must ensure religion state separation. Pakistan's Founder Muhammad Ali Jinnah declared:
> You are free; you are free to go to your temples, you are free to go to your mosques or to any other place of worship in this State of Pakistan. You may belong to any religion or caste or creed. That has nothing to do with the business of the State.
Sadly, the Government of Pakistan violated this sacred principle, which was at the core of Pakistan's founding. Worse yet, this persecution has since spread to other nations as well. Pakistan's Second Amendment represents a grotesque violation of Pakistan's own Constitution, including Article 20, which protects the right of every citizen to profess, practice and propagate their religion, and its founding promise of universal religious freedom. It furthermore violates the International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights ("ICCPR"), which Pakistan has ratified. This Amendment enabled more aggressive and violent discrimination against Ahmadi Muslims--which soon followed as punitive law.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ab27a276-c1a3-430d-8e49-5bf13eda0450?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Building on the Second Amendment, on April 26, 1984, Pakistan's Dictator General Zia-ul-Haq issued Ordinance XX, adding sections 298-B and 298-C to the Pakistan Penal Code. These sections made it a crime for Ahmadis to self-identify as Muslims or practice their faith, imposing severe penalties, including fine, imprisonment, and capital punishment. These provisions also ban Ahmadi Muslims from voting, holding office, performing the Hajj pilgrimage, printing or distributing any religious literature, holding public assembly, or being buried in Muslim cemeteries.
Over the years this apartheid has resulted in horrific violence perpetrated against Ahmadi Muslims, only for their faith. This includes [mass murdering 93 Ahmadi Muslims during worship services in their mosques](https://substack.com/redirect/a154dd7d-951a-481a-9fc8-eab86ac8e3bb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in Lahore, [burning villages and killing Ahmadi women and children in the process](https://substack.com/redirect/65a548fe-ebdb-4a99-8458-fed6899891eb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and [destroying and desecrating countless cemeteries and mosques built by the Ahmadiyya Muslim Community](https://substack.com/redirect/9a1aa476-780a-4883-8b84-5db00cc43010?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c03a196d-7468-4ad9-9346-b89227d4ddc8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
And lest anyone assume this violence is in response to any action taken by Ahmadi Muslims, it is categorically one sided. Throughout the Ahmadiyya Muslim Community's history dating back to 1889, no example exists of an Ahmadi Muslim committing religious violence, or endorsing religious violence. Ahmadi Muslims believe Islam can never endorse aggressive violence, terrorism, or theocracy. Instead, Islam mandates universal religious freedom, service to all humanity without discrimination, and separation of religion and state.
As a result of this overwhelming discriminatory legislation, Ahmadi Muslims in Pakistan live under a system of apartheid. Thousands of Ahmadi Muslims have been charged, arrested and imprisoned under the anti-Ahmadi and blasphemy laws; police routinely destroy Ahmadi Muslim mosques and desecrate the community's gravestones; clerics and politicians alike hurl abuse at and incite violence toward Ahmadi Muslims; and consequently terrorists have murdered hundreds of Ahmadi Muslims with impunity. Even now, Pakistan is erupting in celebrations marking half a century of apartheid against Ahmadi Muslims.

## **Human rights groups condemn the persecution**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/39fc0d6f-843a-45b6-bc49-4bbf94aced04?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Numerous human rights organizations including [Amnesty International](https://substack.com/redirect/a9885cd3-6d6d-42b6-aa5f-f2f2e4893442?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), Humanity First, and the [US Commission on International Religious Freedom](https://substack.com/redirect/5caccef4-42e1-4274-bc87-136be630f687?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) have loudly condemned this state sanctioned persecution against Ahmadi Muslims. In 2021 the UN Office of the High Commissioner for Human Rights ("OHCHR") issued a detailed report on the systemic state sanctioned persecution of Ahmadi Muslims in Pakistan and numerous other countries. The report provides at least eight urgent recommendations to counter these injustices. In part, [the OHCHR report observes](https://substack.com/redirect/5ff82ea0-0917-4fa1-ac2c-5a3c949bcbc0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> Of particular concern are the constitutional provisions, special ordinances, ministerial decrees, or religious edicts that stigmatize and discriminate against the Ahmadiyya community in countries such as Indonesia and Pakistan, and which prohibit Ahmadis from identifying themselves as Muslims, freely expressing their beliefs, practicing their faith, and from effectively participating in public life. Ahmadis are often denied access to public-service employment on religious grounds and are particularly vulnerable to violations under laws on offences relating to religion (blasphemy laws). They are also targeted by laws regulating new technologies and social media platforms, with the aim to suppress their dissenting views and beliefs, enhance control of their minority communities and further increase their persecution through coordinated online hate campaigns and, in certain cases, online coordinated acts of collective punishment.
> Furthermore, we note with grave concern the application of discriminatory regulations that appear to aim at denying Ahmadis' fundamental freedoms as citizens, including inter alia their voting rights and their access to identification documents, as well as imposing administrative obstacles in the enjoyment of their right to form and maintain associations.
Yet despite these efforts, the violent persecution of Ahmadi Muslims persists. Indeed, even when yours truly ran for US Congress here in the United States, intolerant clerics issued edicts condemning me for my faith as an Ahmadi Muslim--even going as far as to threaten the broader Muslim community with _excommunication_ for supporting my candidacy. Fortunately, a number of thoughtful, compassion, and sincere members of the broader Muslim community were vociferous in their support of my candidacy, and rejection of the religious hatred hurled against me. I am grateful to those thoughtful neighbors, and I am likewise hopeful that more such thoughtful and compassionate people reject religious bigotry and embrace service to humanity.

## **In conclusion**
Today the Ahmadiyya Muslim Community is at the forefront of global humanitarian aid. From supporting [critical medical and food aid in Gaza](https://substack.com/redirect/f19cdf4a-51d2-498c-8b33-017572b832b2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), to [feeding Ukrainian refugees](https://substack.com/redirect/d0f1576b-ecc4-4c4c-b33f-11cb78680493?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), to [combatting the Rohingya genocide](https://substack.com/redirect/59c50adc-beb8-4668-9085-81a9e9dc5130?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), to [building hundreds of free schools and hospitals globally to serve all humanity indiscriminately](https://substack.com/redirect/c48cfa47-fe17-4bcd-a646-04db9a6c6911?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--Ahmadi Muslims continue to exemplify their faith globally through relentless efforts of no strings attached service to all humanity. And despite the persecution, the community continues to grow.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7f246c26-1c92-4c28-af32-f3b51304abcc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
While mosques built by Ahmadi Muslims in Pakistan are shut down and destroyed, Ahmadi Muslims inaugurate Bait ul Futuh, the United Kingdom's largest mosque in 2023.
The bottom line is this. Ahmadi Muslims in Pakistan are peaceful law abiding citizens. Ahmadi Muslims in Pakistan should be entitled to the same rights and privilege as all citizens of Pakistan according to Pakistan's Constitution. They should be entitled to those same rights and privileges as all citizens of Pakistan according to the ICCPR, which Pakistan has ratified.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/cd6ef879-0ad6-4bd8-ae1a-4d29baba63bc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Top to Bottom - National peace conferences of the Ahmadiyya Muslim Community in the United Kingdom, in Ghana, and in India. The Community hosts annual peace conferences, known as Jalsa Salana, in most of the 200 nations in which it is established. These events have been banned in Pakistan since 1984.
Instead, Ahmadi Muslims are denied those fundamental rights, and tragically suffer state sanctioned persecution via Pakistan's Second Amendment and unlawful denial of their faith identity. We must stand united, people of all faiths and no faith, backgrounds, ethnicities, nationalities, and diversity, on the principle that justice, human rights, and freedom of conscience must supersede all differences of faith,
The Government of Pakistan must uphold its obligations under its own Constitution, under the ICCPR, and according to its own founding principles, and immediately and urgently repeal the Second Amendment to Pakistan's Constitution.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/6c848e7a-a294-48b0-b1b6-278e05877e2a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Muhammad Ali Jinnah (December 25, 1876 - September 11, 1948) Founder and First Governor General of Pakistan
Fifty years of apartheid and Pakistan's decline are enough. It is time to meet the founding promise of Pakistan with sincerity, as Pakistan's Founder Muhammad Ali Jinnah envisioned. In an address to the United States less than a year after Pakistan's creation, Jinnah [declared and reaffirmed Pakistan's commitment](https://substack.com/redirect/bfff726d-6e25-4f9a-8889-24154aa45914?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to freedom and pluralism:
> In any case Pakistan is not going to be a theocratic State to be ruled by priests with a divine mission. We have many non-Muslims -- Hindus, Christians, and Parsis -- but they are all Pakistanis. They will enjoy the same rights and privileges as any other citizens and will play their rightful part in the affairs of Pakistan.
For those interested in reading a more comprehensive analysis of the persecution Ahmadi Muslims face, [here's a link to download my peer reviewed law review article on the subject](https://substack.com/redirect/949a0c05-ca29-4eba-8ac3-d4f1dfc13939?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). To reiterate, I am not being hyperbolic when I state that I would be arrested for writing this article in Pakistan. Just last year [an Ahmadi lawyer in Pakistan was arrested for having "Syed" in his name](https://substack.com/redirect/a7f39860-cb9a-444d-b7f6-9beb36354e51?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and thus 'illegally posing as a Muslim.' And precisely because this article would be criminally banned in Pakistan, it is that much more important that we who are privileged enough to enjoy free speech, use it for those who cannot. We do not end apartheid by ignoring it, but by facing it head on and dismantling it with facts and truth--educating one thoughtful person at a time. Thank you for helping spread the word for the cause of justice and humanity.

They are also targeted by laws regulating new technologies and social media platforms, with the aim to suppress their dissenting views and beliefs, enhance control of their minority communities and further increase their persecution through coordinated online hate campaigns and, in certain cases, online coordinated acts of collective punishment. Furthermore, we note with grave concern the application of discriminatory regulations that appear to aim at denying Ahmadis' fundamental freedoms as citizens, including inter alia their voting rights and their access to identification documents, as well as imposing administrative obstacles in the enjoyment of their right to form and maintain associations. Yet despite these efforts, the violent persecution of Ahmadi Muslims persists. Indeed, even when yours truly ran for US Congress here in the United States, intolerant clerics issued edicts condemning me for my faith as an Ahmadi Muslim--even going as far as to threaten the broader Muslim community with excommunication for supporting my candidacy. Fortunately, a number of thoughtful, compassion, and sincere members of the broader Muslim community were vociferous in their support of my candidacy, and rejection of the religious hatred hurled against me. I am grateful to those thoughtful neighbors, and I am likewise hopeful that more such thoughtful and compassionate people reject religious bigotry and embrace service to humanity. In conclusion Today the Ahmadiyya Muslim Community is at the forefront of global humanitarian aid. From supporting , to , to , to Muslims continue to exemplify their faith globally through relentless efforts of no strings attached service to all humanity. And despite the persecution, the community continues to grow. | | ---|---|--- While mosques built by Ahmadi Muslims in Pakistan are shut down and destroyed, Ahmadi Muslims inaugurate Bait ul Futuh, the United Kingdom's largest mosque in 2023. The bottom line is this. Ahmadi Muslims in Pakistan are peaceful law abiding citizens. Ahmadi Muslims in Pakistan should be entitled to the same rights and privilege as all citizens of Pakistan according to Pakistan's Constitution. They should be entitled to those same rights and privileges as all citizens of Pakistan according to the ICCPR, which Pakistan has ratified. | | ---|---|--- Top to Bottom - National peace conferences of the Ahmadiyya Muslim Community in the United Kingdom, in Ghana, and in India. The Community hosts annual peace conferences, known as Jalsa Salana, in most of the 200 nations in which it is established. These events have been banned in Pakistan since 1984. Instead, Ahmadi Muslims are denied those fundamental rights, and tragically suffer state sanctioned persecution via Pakistan's Second Amendment and unlawful denial of their faith identity. We must stand united, people of all faiths and no faith, backgrounds, ethnicities, nationalities, and diversity, on the principle that justice, human rights, and freedom of conscience must supersede all differences of faith, The Government of Pakistan must uphold its obligations under its own Constitution, under the ICCPR, and according to its own founding principles, and immediately and urgently repeal the Second Amendment to Pakistan's Constitution. | | ---|---|--- Muhammad Ali Jinnah (December 25, 1876 - September 11, 1948) Founder and First Governor General of Pakistan Fifty years of apartheid and Pakistan's decline are enough. It is time to meet the founding promise of Pakistan with sincerity, as Pakistan's Founder Muhammad Ali Jinnah envisioned. In an address to the United States less than a year after Pakistan's creation, Jinnah to freedom and pluralism: In any case Pakistan is not going to be a theocratic State to be ruled by priests with a divine mission. We have many non-Muslims -- Hindus, Christians, and Parsis -- but they are all Pakistanis. They will enjoy the same rights and privileges as any other citizens and will play their rightful part in the affairs of Pakistan. For those interested in reading a more comprehensive analysis of the persecution Ahmadi Muslims face, . To reiterate, I am not being hyperbolic when I state that I would be arrested for writing this article in Pakistan. Just last year , and thus 'illegally posing as a Muslim.' And precisely because this article would be criminally banned in Pakistan, it is that much more important that we who are privileged enough to enjoy free speech, use it for those who cannot. We do not end apartheid by ignoring it, but by facing it head on and dismantling it with facts and truth--educating one thoughtful person at a time. Thank you for helping spread the word for the cause of justice and humanity. Why Your Support Matters:** Every dollar we spend is a vote for the kind of future we want. Hi Peter, I'm Sarah McBride.
I’m a Democrat running to represent my home state of Delaware in Congress, and the team at Leaders We Deserve said I could reach out to you about our historic campaign.
**In 2020, with the help of supporters just like you, I defied the odds and became the first openly trans person elected to serve as a State Senator anywhere in the country.**
It really felt like America was blazing a path to the future.
But since then, the far-right has tried to use the LGBTQ+ community as a scapegoat for their own policy failures. As they’ve increased their attacks on families and kids, it has become even more clear: _for our democracy to work, it needs to include all of us._
**We need to have a trans representative at the table in Congress.**
Thanks to the support I’ve received in Delaware and across the country, we have a real shot of winning this race and finally shattering this national lavender glass ceiling, Peter.
**But we know that ring-wing donors are lining up to dump serious cash and lob hateful attacks between now and November to defeat our campaign. That’s why I need your help right now to fight back.**
[**Peter, can you please split a donation of $5 between my campaign and Leaders We Deserve to help us finally elect an out trans person to Congress? Sarah McBride

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

Friend, Anti-Palestinian lobbying group AIPAC pledged to spend $100 million influencing 2024’s elections, and they’ve already surpassed that amount. Funded mainly by far-right billionaires, AIPAC spent $30 million this summer to unseat two of the most progressive members of Congress, making Jamaal Bowman and Cori Bush’s congressional primary elections the most expensive in U.S. history. **This influx of billionaire spending drowns out the voices of everyday voters, making it virtually impossible for working-class candidates to run for office and win.** **Already, more than half of members of Congress are millionaires.** They can’t relate to the struggles of ordinary Americans, and they don’t understand how quickly we need bold changes to end poverty and ensure that everyone can thrive. In a recent poll, more than 8 in 10 U.S. adults reported that “special interest groups and lobbyists have too much say in what happens in politics.” This level of influence—powered by Big Money interests—erodes our democracy and blocks much-needed progress. **[Can you sign today to urge Congress to act now to limit the influence of Big Money in politics and hand the power back to the people?](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38h9nrsCCiMen3CGd5zila9jzJnep0tjRIZRggydvVqTJ7RyQRhOYHXeUNck8p79twjAVTrdGCjyrtXJfisYnAOZ4ffxbzXCLd4W-3wU5Gl-GK8Ylq1InkgFZ8KY4J_8J1jMEljeQaNnKwICByer-oA2lmoRe9vQH8TlXH88uTzuSmxYKX_iAfQdykc6U-k3c25DJn4cgqbfup_Tf-VGRQTy2iXMx7Wcm3gWSLWvDfkwUFpp2SzkBOAwVd3RDHxCscr9XSKwgLEfZNDoWXV4NFLrpxqfzQEDEHGOh0c172RRTqV943PUaHT2R7FHdPuy3nsXeJiGcqief5YKWFyq2HnqrGNC2Opl1JS7ERwBvjyS8nOnxK7ga6hYg1ryJFD-bV9BRDWhfcLDUCfTmrJCLDJZofmxufkyfxpfiMvYq8PiVm-gMQsbvzL37E2wW_iKSI/49k/W-CUEBCbQ1ue-hil0rVesw/h1/h001.MgCId2PdoOyGWRYnEeaEPU_1KcIf_IzLRmeNZWsEJXw)** | [SIGN NOW](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38h9nrsCCiMen3CGd5zila9jzJnep0tjRIZRggydvVqTJ7RyQRhOYHXeUNck8p79twjAVTrdGCjyrtXJfisYnAOZ4ffxbzXCLd4W-3wU5Gl-GK8Ylq1InkgFZ8KY4J_8J1jMEljeQaNnKwICByer-oA2lmoRe9vQH8TlXH88uTzuSmxYKX_iAfQdykc6U-k3c33MKYYmiV4c1Dk5J2-PFpGlwuljgWL-LMtwbrolJ2Bt7ZzqEEK2yuAPoA4ahbPbLTtjgrTzERCuN5JXbhCjjVgnlKonC-XD_EvpB7dNJZzOxE9zyuAn0Yx0JgGGS89jKpOLFuwbu8VJNLcArecckQh90VJG7NU_Oq_S0-Y2NAPcSz3hNzs98Ir6-mE2JJC1lz1DrNNj6U7I9iaqh6aIs0Sf_rCceASocX9V--i0Cvwm-ldILbku4olA0-25Ot7O-A/49k/W-CUEBCbQ1ue-hil0rVesw/h2/h001.3O4f5xy1UeqnCBL6BE1ScuJp1z49XKOhoOjvLVi8jjo)

**To earn back public trust in government and better represent the people,****I’m a proud co-sponsor of legislation to expand campaign finance reforms** —including the **_Protecting Our Democracy Act_** to hold elected officials accountable and get dark money out of politics, the **_DISCLOSE Act_** _of 2023_ to require additional transparency in elections, and the **_Democracy for All Amendment_** to **overturn**** _Citizens United_** __ and limit corporate campaign spending while encouraging public campaign financing.
We also need anti-corruption policies, because members of Congress were elected to serve the public, not to serve their stock portfolios. I introduced the **_Stop Politicians Profiting from War Act_****** to ban members of Congress from investing in weapons contractors. They should not be able to use their positions of power to get rich while voting to pass more funding to bomb innocent civilians.
**Right now, a majority of Congresspeople receive money from AIPAC:** 342 out of 535 members of Congress. This is partly why my colleagues are still voting to support Israel’s atrocities against the Palestinian people, even though the majority of Americans want to stop sending U.S. weapons to Israel.
**The biggest source of Republican money into Democratic elections, AIPAC keeps spending more each year to buy our elections.** The group’s donors also financially support Trump’s re-election campaign, Atlanta’s Cop City, and attacks on workers’ rights and abortion rights. They want to take down members of Congress who represent working-class people and who want to create a government that works for everyone rather than just the wealthy few.
**Already in 2024, just 50 billionaires have spent more than $600 million on elections in an attempt to rig our government even more in their favor.** Right-wing billionaires are afraid of our progressive movement to change the unjust status quo, and now they’re emboldened to influence our politics even more.

Peter, we made some difficult decisions this week.
We sit in on meetings everyday with our television and digital advertising teams where we try to figure out how we’re going to divide up our resources. Frankly, we’re on defense across the map right now, and too many of our friends need help.
At this point in the cycle we’d like to be expanding our map out — taking the fight to more MAGA-right Republicans and supporting our own candidates. But right now, we’re having conversations about where we might need to scale back.
We needed to decide what to do about it, and we remembered the SAS motto: “Who dares wins.”
We can’t leave our team out to dry. We’re not going to cede the country to Trump and the MAGA-right. We committed to the spend, even though the money wasn’t in the budget yet.
That leaves us with a budget gap, though — and we’re writing to you in the hopes that you’ll step up and help us fill it. We really can’t afford to fall short right now. Not with one of the last official FEC deadlines of the cycle right around the corner.

body:
Why America Matters | ACI

Please read the following message
from our sponsor.

Fellow American,

Are you worried about the rising influence of
radical ideologies in today's schools? I know I am.

That's why I have created the Little Patriots
Program. This program provides curriculum for grades K-5 that
teaches the REAL history of America, promoting the values of
faith, liberty, community, and life that made our nation great.

This innovative approach makes learning history fun
for our children while instilling in them a profound love and
respect for our country.

But, in order to keep this curriculum free of
charge, I need your support.

I have written a book, Why America Matters.
Intended for young readers, this book creates a deeper
understanding of the importance of our country and the respect
that it deserves.

I want to send you a copy for a gift of $25 or
more. To give a gift use this secure link:
https://secure.americancornerstone.org/why-america-matters-donate

All proceeds from your donation will go directly to
supporting our Little Patriots Program, ensuring that we can keep
creating curricula and cartoons that show the history of America.

You can help shape the minds of our future leaders
today and give them the best possible resources.

Your gift of $25 or more will get you access to my
book, Why America Matters, and help us reach more children with
the truth.

Sincerely,

Dr. Ben Carson

Founder and Chairman

American Cornerstone Institute

Your donation to ACI helps us to focus on our
mission of promoting and preserving individual and religious
liberty, helping our country's most vulnerable find new hope, and

citizens.

body:
Our campaign is working to get out the vote in key battleground states across the country:
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20240907-4271-footer&t=1&akid=4271%2E420207%2EwsGaqe)
Don’t let all the excitement around the Harris-Walz campaign make you complacent, Peter.
**We’re still in the middle of an incredibly close campaign, and winning the White House _and_ the House in November is going to take a lot of work.**
That’s why Pramila’s not just organizing here in Seattle. Our campaign is working to get out the vote in key battleground states across the country.
We’ve launched phonebanks and grassroots organizing efforts — and have sent Pramila herself to launch doorknocking shifts — in key states. Here is where we are focusing our investments:
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-20240907?refcode=em20240907&amount=3&refcode2=4271_420207_wsGaqe&akid=4271%2E420207%2EwsGaqe)
**[Pitch in now to help!](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-20240907?amount=3&refcode=em20240907-4271&refcode2=4271_420207_wsGaqe&akid=4271%2E420207%2EwsGaqe)**
This is what it’s going to take if we’re actually going to make progress on our shared progressive priorities. **Paid leave, the child tax credit, gun reform, restoring abortion rights** — all of these are nonstarters if Donald Trump wins or Republicans keep the House.
And in an election this close, every door knocked, every call placed, and every dollar donated can be the difference between winning and losing.
Pramila is doing everything she can to make our agenda a reality, but we need your help. **We’re a 100% grassroots-funded movement** , and we count on contributions to emails like this one to fund our work.

body:
Every Oregon child should have a safe, supportive place to receive a high-quality public education |
#
---
Peter, Oregon students are headed back to school. I was one of those kids who looked forward to getting back in the classroom every fall. Sure, I loved the summer break, but I also loved seeing my friends and learning new things at school. I want that same kind of excitement for every Oregon student. And that’s why I want Oregon’s schools to be the best they can be for every child. **_Here’s how we’re going to get it done:_** 📚 Invest in early literacy programs to ensure all students are reading by third grade and all educators have the tools they need to support every student. 💵Request an additional $500 million increase in education funding to address budget gaps faced by our school districts. 🧑🏫 Increase summer learning programs around the state, to ensure our students stay on track during the summer months. ➕ ... and so much more! Every Oregon child should have a safe, supportive place to receive a high-quality public education. Our team is working hard to make that a reality here in Oregon. ---
Hello Friend,

Despite court rulings in Louisiana and Oklahoma that make the teaching of the Bible and the 10 Commandments mandatory in public schools and universities, we still live in a time when the foundational teachings of the Ten Commandments are no longer emphasized in our public schools and daily lives. As a result, our children are growing up without these essential, God-honoring rules for living.

In this culture of moral confusion, the Ten Commandments provide clear, simple answers about what it means to live a righteous life. Teaching these commandments to children not only instills a sense of security and purpose but also fosters emotional resilience, intellectual acuity, and ethical integrity. The Ten Commandments uphold traditional values and celebrate the family unit as foundational to society, helping children navigate life's challenges with confidence and grace.
---
| | That's why I'm excited to introduce my brand new kids book, _The 10 Commandments for Kids_ book. This book offers kids ten Bible lessons about God's simple rules for living, with each chapter explaining one commandment, discussion questions, applications, and prayers to say together. It's a trustworthy resource for children to read on their own, during church services, or as part of vacation Bible school studies.
---
| [](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=c0ec78a0b2e74f058e1f46210b45004e&_e=NUmLUP1Batkk75vve8txL4HdNkfYIndUK7gQ4H3RO3VRE1CviJfBd0lWYLvp_CImdruqyUHH7NBDHbW3gzsWBFI5outUWW760z0sZmASyMmzvgwY2RzAFA7fOma0CxZl1Vm_qrR8F5hlQ6tpmVESsQR2iGdMjTK6QGa1a--07Ve2BH-ZJNUfn5Q-IrBgWoB1Ts5Cf_ME_1x_d3thGtC3lEI7MHN2um09n901Vel4PsZNkuFDfkYuYKEjuAg-PBdeehfUYxIyHJJ3kN4ooT1S_csvmSztDUhXditARuNylk4gs-8MjB48EiHdxy1s4aJp7d1K5DV1O_TZQqTt3ML5G2wHRyxQUwGyaK4DKJWJTn3qTdnHJ9fIUlwCF-q_xz8F)
---
| | Additionally, for the adults in your life, I've written,_The 10: How to Live and Love in a World That Has Lost Its Way_. This book will refresh your understanding and application of the Ten Commandments, showing how living by these principles can improve our personal lives, relationships, churches, and communities.

**I encourage you to point your children or grandchildren towards Jesus Christ.**

For a gift of any amount to support Pathway to Victory, I will send you both books: [https://secure.ptv.org/the-10-commandments-for-kids-generous-gift-1](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=c0ec78a0b2e74f058e1f46210b45004e&_e=NUmLUP1Batkk75vve8txL4HdNkfYIndUK7gQ4H3RO3VRE1CviJfBd0lWYLvp_CImdruqyUHH7NBDHbW3gzsWBFI5outUWW760z0sZmASyMmzvgwY2RzAFA7fOma0CxZl1Vm_qrR8F5hlQ6tpmVESsQR2iGdMjTK6QGa1a--07Ve2BH-ZJNUfn5Q-IrBgWoB1Ts5Cf_ME_1x_d3thGtC3lEI7MHN2um09n901Vel4PsbRHGCqS7K2JaG9S7ohUM88gV7HSP3KRiYchcmXdBznJpS7Eocs8qyZxJTF5EGsILmloajAm6inXJd6tmSWnTQszJpzm7g7nfmojeb76TF83KK0jzGa_qo_QbThkq8xh6m9e_DDYa1yKumi7id2ZGVv)

Your generosity enables _Pathway to Victory_ to share bold biblical truths with a broken world. Together, we will make a difference and bring people closer to Christ.

Thank you for standing with us and sharing the gospel of Jesus Christ.

Sharing the Truth of God's Word,

Dr. Robert Jeffress

body:

The latest Vance revelation is more bad news for Donald Trump. Despite hundreds of connections between his campaign and Project 2025, Trump has been trying to distance himself from the right-wing plan to take over the government.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92366057/496872552/-593472309?refcode=20240907-EM-FoxNews2025&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNTg3YzIxOWQtM2E2ZC1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=GRoDu9qsuEoDaDnp3eSMaXiglGPOPgsW1Q1-x2JB3y8=)

So that’s the bad news. The good news? COURIER and our eleven battleground newsrooms across the country are working around the clock to expose Project 2025 and fight back. Just take a look:

body:
Team Hudson is working hard every day to ensure MI-3 returns to responsive representation focused on positive and tangible actions not platitudes and words. This has been a busy week for us.
| | |
---
| [](https://5hqec7gbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001Wvqt70oYmh9NjztuvQxL0PqWEPV19nKctexNaNVC0j9xm6UuzPa6lcBGjM9p-BM15309BBOfFOIUUXYtmKUWVqi2TpeRlrSinzCgyrCDbJmsGspNRwAZDcfRsf1jqaU21LGAYqYfp0bdtNOSZZNOmqkXTq4PxvZ_tyLuiZOlWgk=&c=law_br-Xp4hvTNP6wiXZi-Q54YYUj6GD-87qyCYlb3CSfg4HaJdd7A==&ch=kOWMzSGzH-f4zS7ycqNL6JcOIhwulAboRVRrhHrz6H0Odl0N2f8Gkg==)

|
Friend

I hope you all had a wonderful Labor Day holiday weekend and that you took some time to refresh before the fall rush kicked off this week. The school year is now in full swing and our attention turns to the future. Education is one of the most important investments a community can make. But despite constantly expanding education budgets, our results in this state are plummeting! Per pupil spending is up to roughly $10k a year, yet Michigan's education ranking has tumbled to 42nd in the nation, and 60% of Michigan third graders can't read. This is a disastrous record, and it's time to try something new. If you, like me, think a failure of this magnitude deserves consequences, please join us in helping Hillary retire on January 1, 2025.
---
---
|
---
|
### NRCC Chairman Hudson Visits West Michigan
This week we had the privilege of spending time with Chairman Richard Hudson of the NRCC (great last name!) and Congressmen Moolenaar and Huizenga.
We are all closely aligned in working hard to win back MI-3 and restoring it to common sense conservative leadership. West Michigan is ready for someone who matches the marketing materials, not someone who poses as a "moderate" but then votes party-line progressive 96% of the time.
---
|

---
|
### Remembering a Local Hero
Friday was a special night under the lights as we honored Captain Miguel Nava, who tragically died serving his country this year. It was a true honor spending time with his wife Ryann and soon to be one year old son along with the whole Nava family.
The very best of humanity was on display here at Comstock Park, with the whole community - including a 97 year old WWII veteran(!) - coming together to support our neighbors in a wrenching time.
---
|
---
|
---

clean_body: Team Hudson is working hard every day to ensure MI-3 returns to responsive representation focused on positive and tangible actions not platitudes and words. This has been a busy week for us. | | | | == | Friend I hope you all had a wonderful Labor Day holiday weekend and that you took some time to refresh before the fall rush kicked off this week. The school year is now in full swing and our attention turns to the future. Education is one of the most important investments a community can make. But despite constantly expanding education budgets, our results in this state are plummeting! Per pupil spending is up to roughly $10k a year, yet Michigan's education ranking has tumbled to 42nd in the nation, and 60% of Michigan third graders can't read. This is a disastrous record, and it's time to try something new. If you, like me, think a failure of this magnitude deserves consequences, please join us in helping Hillary retire on January 1, 2025. | | NRCC Chairman Hudson Visits West Michigan This week we had the privilege of spending time with Chairman Richard Hudson of the NRCC (great last name!) and Congressmen Moolenaar and Huizenga. We are all closely aligned in working hard to win back MI-3 and restoring it to common sense conservative leadership. West Michigan is ready for someone who matches the marketing materials, not someone who poses as a "moderate" but then votes party-line progressive 96% of the time. | | Remembering a Local Hero Friday was a special night under the lights as we honored Captain Miguel Nava, who tragically died serving his country this year. It was a true honor spending time with his wife Ryann and soon to be one year old son along with the whole Nava family. The very best of humanity was on display here at Comstock Park, with the whole community - including a 97 year old WWII veteran(!) - coming together to support our neighbors in a wrenching time. | | | | The Election is Only 59 DAYS AWAY and V== Join us on September 14th as we knock doors with Tommy Brann! | | | mailto:josh@paulhudsonforcongress.com | We humbly ask your support to join our team by volunteering to help knock some doors or supporting our effort financially. This election is critical! We don't just need your vote, we also need you to remind your friends to get out and vote as well. Together, we can win this election and build a safer, stronger, and freer West Michigan for all! As always, never hesitate to reach out. -- Team Hudson | == | == | == | mailto:TEAMHUDSON@PAULHUDSONFORCONGRESS.COM | == == == == | == | == | == E-mail is one of the best ways to connect with voters, however I realize how off-putting they can sometimes be. While I hope you'll stay connected and continue to follow my campaign, I understand if you wish to disconnect and focus your energy on more important things like family or work. name: Justice Democrats
subject: The Democratic Party can no longer allow AIPAC to buy our elections.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter, did you see
this news last week?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240907.utPyqv&refcode=em20240907-35974&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=35974%2E1203867%2ENkezxY ]Tweet from Sludge: BREAKING: AIPAC has officially surpassed the $100
million spending mark on 2024 U.S. elections.

AIPAC, the anti-Palestinian, right-wing megadonor-funded lobby group, has
officially spent more than $100 million in federal elections this year,
most of which came from MAGA millionaires and billionaires.

More than $25 million was spent by AIPAC and its Super PAC in Justice
Democrats’ Cori Bush and Jamaal Bowman’s Democratic primary elections,
where the group recruited and backed corrupt, conservative challengers.

This is what “democracy” looks like? A single-issue lobby group buying our
elections?

Democratic Party leadership has been complacent about this for way too
long, Peter. They let AIPAC
spend a historic amount of money to successfully unseat some of the only
working-class members of Congress we have. What will happen next cycle if
they allow this to continue?

If we’re going to reform our broken campaign finance system, end Citizens
United, and get dark money out of politics, the Party MUST reject AIPAC
once and for all, as soon as possible.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240907.utPyqv&refcode=em20240907-35974&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1003&akid=35974%2E1203867%2ENkezxY ]Justice Democrats is leading the call for the Democratic Party to act
on its values and stop taking money from this lobby group and others that
threaten our democracy. If you can, chip in any amount today to fuel our
work — we can’t do it without you →

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240907.utPyqv&refcode=em20240907-35974&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1022&akid=35974%2E1203867%2ENkezxY ]Contribute $5

Thank you for anything you can contribute to power our mission in the days
ahead.

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

Contribute to Justice Democrats: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/justicedemocrats?refcode=em20240907-35974-footer&t=1023&refcode2=35974_1203867_NkezxY&akid=35974%2E1203867%2ENkezxY

Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. | | | Peter,
As you’ve likely heard, Robert F Kennedy, Jr. has suspended his Presidential campaign and joined forces with Trump. Known for being an outspoken proponent of vaccine safety, Kennedy not only brought the issue front and center during the pandemic but also made it a cornerstone of his campaign.
As the founder of Children’s Health Defense, Kennedy is an unmatched fighter against federal agency capture. For this reason, he has received sharp criticism for pointing out that, “of the 72 vaccine doses now mandated for American children, none of them - not one - has ever been subject to a pre-licensing placebo-controlled trial.” He even went on to sue the Department of Health and Human Services for failing to produce the documentation that could prove that a safety study for any vaccine on the childhood schedule had been performed!
Meanwhile, according to their official website, Kamala Harris still requires anyone interested in joining the Harris-Walz campaign staff to be “up to date” on COVID-19 vaccination status as prescribed by the CDC. Unbelievable!

Having a staunch vaccine choice champion like Kennedy join Trump’s campaign is tremendous news for those of us who are ready to Make America Healthy Again! We are hopeful that with Kennedy’s expertise and passion in this field, systemic change is possible!!

Our new book, _The Perilous Fight_ , addresses these issues head-on, offering practical insights and solutions to restore and strengthen the family unit.

Why is this important? Because the family's pivotal role in our society is under threat, and without addressing these challenges, our foundational values may be lost. We’ll handle all of the printing and mailing to get your postcards delivered by Election Day. Can’t make any of our upcoming trainings? No worries! The Working Families Party Selfie Postcard program empowers you to reach the people in your life with a reminder to vote that they can hang on their fridge. Your postcards can provide valuable information, like instructions to make a plan to vote or background on a WFP champion near them. And by having the postcard come from you, Peter, you’re helping make voting a priority for your loved ones — they’ll know that you’re counting on them to make their voices heard! | **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

I’m here to tell you that your vote counts every year, in every election – but especially this year, in this election , because the path to a Democratic House majority runs directly through California . name: Adam Schiff
subject: What Trump said about Jewish voters
disclaimer_text: Paid for by ECU Non-federal
body:
| [ ](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/26910?t=1&akid=22010%2E4449941%2EjzXaaC)
---
Team,

At his absolutely ridiculous, rambling Mar-a-Lago press conference last month, Donald Trump made a whole host of outrageous comments and claims.

This one didn’t make a huge splash amidst the other insane things he said, but it stood out to me: _**"If anybody I know is Jewish and they would vote for Kamala over me, they should have their heads examined."**_ Well, I am Jewish. And I am proudly going to cast my vote for Vice President Kamala Harris. But I certainly don’t want my head examined by Donald Trump.

I’m proud of my Jewish faith, friend. From a young age, Judaism has guided my values. Especially the teaching of Tikkun Olam, or repairing the world.

Over the last few years, there has been a lot that was broken, and a lot to fix.

But Tikkun Olam guides me in the fight we face today: repairing and rebuilding our democracy so that we leave it better for my children and yours.

That’s why I put everything I have into my work in Congress and for the cause of our democracy. It’s the first thing I think about when I wake up in the morning, and I don’t rest until I’ve done all I can for the day. [**If these priorities resonate with you, I’m asking for your help to continue that work by chipping in a split donation of $10 or another meaningful amount between my campaign and Fight for Reform to help them elect state and local Democrats. Together, we can repair the world and restore the strength of our democracy after the damage inflicted by Donald Trump.**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/50356?t=7&akid=22010%2E4449941%2EjzXaaC) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Fight for Reform and Adam Schiff will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $10 »](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/50357?t=8&akid=22010%2E4449941%2EjzXaaC)

Thank you for taking the time to learn more about my views and background. I’m a proud Jewish voter who will cast a ballot for Kamala Harris this November — and sorry, Donald, but I’m not the one who needs their head examined!

— Adam

Health care for all: expanding Medicare to include vision, hearing, and

continuing the fight for Medicare for All!

enriching CEOs with stock buybacks.

DNC to reject AIPAC’s right-wing money.

big polluters at Big Oil, secure massive investments in renewable energy; and
protect the natural world from drilling and logging.

Peace in Gaza: end U.S support for Netanyahu’s bombing of innocent
Palestinians and secure a Ceasefire.

Economic Justice: raise the minimum wage to a living wage; protect and expand
Social Security; end price gouging at the grocery store; end the flow of
taxpayer money to endless wars and defense contractors; and invest in public
education and public school teachers.

There’s so much more. And our movement can win Bernie’s wishlist if we keep

pass policies for the PEOPLE.

I will always be a soldier at heart — but I am also so much more. I am a husband, a father, a business owner, and a follower of Jesus Christ. I’m running for Senate because I believe in America, and because I believe in answering the call to serve. I have lived a life of service and sacrifice. Now, I’m ready to continue that mission in Washington, DC. Because I believe that this is the greatest nation on earth — and it is worth fighting for! Hello,
The system is rigged. We all know it. The only people who can afford to run for Senate full-time are millionaires like my opponent, Republican Deb Fischer.
That’s why they’re the only people who ever win. It’s why the Senate is just another country club full of Ivy League graduates, former business execs, and trust fund babies.
Working people like me, we can’t afford to give up our jobs to run for office. During this campaign, I’ve been working 40, 60, sometimes 90 hours a week as a steamfitter just to pay our bills and put food on the table. How’s anybody with a real job supposed to campaign and win when your opponent is wealthy enough to not work at all?
**That’s why I announced that I am taking a leave from my job as a steamfitter to campaign full-time for the U.S. Senate and keep up our momentum.**
And yes, that means I’m going to need to take a salary from our campaign. Not a big one. Just enough to replace the $48,000 I got paid last year and the cost of health care for me and my family.
Politics shouldn’t only be for the rich, and this is the only way we can change that.
**FIVE polls now show me neck-and-neck with my opponent, Republican Deb Fischer – and in one, I am LEADING her by 2 points.** With support from grassroots donors like you, we even out-raised her during the last quarter! But she still has $2.3 million more than us because of her corporate PAC friends.
Together, we are charting the path for how a blue collar, union worker can run for U.S. Senate – and win. **But I need grassroots donors like you to chip in to my campaign right now if we’re going to defeat Republican Deb Fischer and flip this Senate seat:**

subject: We don't have to live like this.

body:
https://www.engelforarizona.com/ [https://www.engelforarizona.com/]
Peter,
I can’t believe I have to say this, but: we don’t have to accept mass shootings in our schools as a “fact of life.”
What we saw in Georgia this week has become all too common in the United States. Too many parents have felt the terror of hearing that their child is in an active shooter situation at school. Too many children have been forced to hide and cower in the classrooms where they’re supposed to be preparing for the future. And too many lives have been cut short by senseless gun violence.
This isn’t a fact of life. It’s the product of inadequate gun safety in our country.
We don’t have to live like this .
I’m proud to be endorsed by the Brady PAC, the Giffords PAC, and Moms Fed Up, all incredible organizations working to end gun violence in our country. In Congress, I will fight for universal background checks, red flag laws, ending the gun show loophole, and, yes, banning assault weapons.
When it comes to gun violence, my opponent has offered thoughts and prayers — and then turned around and voted to remove restrictions on dangerous firearm devices. But that doesn’t come as a surprise, given his deep ties to a Christian nationalist organization that teaches kids as young as 11 how to shoot and kill with a gun.
Arizona’s Sixth Congressional District deserves better. Our kids deserve better.
I’m running in a frontline race so I can build a safer, better future for Arizona. Every dollar counts, so I have to ask: can you chip in now to make sure we have the resources to flip this seat blue? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/engel2024_email?refcode=X_090724_GunViolence_act]
DONATE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/engel2024_email?refcode=X_090724_GunViolence_act]
DONATE MONTHLY [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/engel2024_email?refcode=X_090724_GunViolence_act&recurring=1]
I won’t give up on this fight.
Thank you,
Kirsten

She’s ready to take that fight to Washington to find common-sense solutions to the challenges we’re facing here in Arizona's Sixth Congressional District.

name: Elissa Slotkin
subject: What I learned from President Obama
disclaimer_text: Paid for by VPP
body:
| Friend,

I want to share a story about someone who, more than anyone, taught me the importance of listening and accountability.

It’s Barack Obama. [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/77450?t=6&akid=16683%2E878179%2ElILYOr) I was in the White House the first day he took office in 2009, serving as a part of his national security staff. I staffed his meetings in the Situation Room and briefed him in the Oval Office. Later, I was honored to be nominated by him to serve in the Pentagon.

Despite his effortless charm in public, President Obama was a very tough boss. I don’t think I’ve ever had a tougher boss than President Obama. He’s brilliant, and he’s got a lawyer’s training where he’ll grill you with difficult questions, one after another.

I learned pretty quickly to be prepared, because he was going to make sure you knew your stuff.

What’s more, he was going to hold you accountable to what you said. If you told him a fact or a plan, you’d better deliver on it. If you didn’t know something, you should say that and not try to fudge your way through it. That’s exactly the approach I try to take in Congress. I try my best to know the details, make thoughtful decisions, and be transparent about what I know and don’t know. Because I’ll never forget the lesson President Obama taught me: you better say what you mean, and mean what you say.

[That’s the kind of Senator I’ll be. And I’m building a grassroots movement in that same spirit to bring accountability to the U.S. Senate. With that in mind, will you chip in $10 to Voter Protection Project and my campaign help us get there?](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/77450?t=7&akid=16683%2E878179%2ElILYOr) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Elissa Slotkin and VPP will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $10 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/77451?t=8&akid=16683%2E878179%2ElILYOr)

# Protecting 2nd Amendment Rights
As a U.S. Congress Candidate from NM District 3, I have seen first hand that violating 2A Rights does not correlate to ending gun violence or violent crimes.
New Mexico Ranks #1 among the 50 states for having the most violent crimes. New Mexico progressive politicians are known for over reaching actions like:
* Red Flag Law (Gives the Government right to take away your firearm without a crime being committed.
* Forcing the closure of Gun Stores during Covid lockdowns (while allowing gun buy back programs.
* The Governor issuing an executive order to criminalize open carry that was deemed unconstitutional.

I am asking for your support to keep this kind of policies out of D.C. and to reinstitute freedom & liberty.

# Curbing Violent Crimes
Party politics have crippled progress while allowing existing problems to grow. Sharon Clahschilliage is here to say that **Protecting 2A Rights & Curbing Violent Crimes Can Coexist. **To begin this we must:
* Protect and police our borders.
* Community Collaboration.
* Keep guns out of the hands of felons.
* Prosecute fairly and justly those who should be felons.
* Keep guns in the hands of law abiding citizens.
* Support law enforcement and protect our schools.
