name: LinebergerforUSCongress
subject: Update from Lineberger for US Congress – September 7th, 2024
body:
Hi Friends of Lineberger for US Congress!

*Get Engaged*. *Stay engaged*. We are down to within the last 60 days
until the election is complete.
October 7th is the last day to register and be able to vote in this
election.
October 21 marks the start of early voting. November 5th is election day!
*What we do now will make all of the difference in the quality of our lives
post-election*.

Big picture items:

Tomorrow morning, Darlene and I are flying to DC on a trip that was planned
long before. We are turning it into a learning / working visit to tour the
Capitol, learn some basics about how the House works, and just see who we
can meet. These are exciting times with a lot of energy and we want to
give back hope to those representatives who have been working for us in the
118th Congress. It won’t be a long trip, but we’ll still be there for the
presidential debate on September 10th. There are a lot of watch parties
around, including the Denton County Democratic Party event at Nico’s in
Carrollton (not far from our house). Please support the event and share
encouragement with your fellow Dem’s while we are away. Here is the
mobilize link: https://www.mobilize.us/dentondemocrats/event/666489/

Soon you may be seeing more from our campaign in multimedia formats. I’ll
list a few.
- Digital Ads have started playing targeting in district voters viewing
streaming television
- Digital Ads will soon be going out on other digital programs
- We have a quarter page Ad in September’s ‘The Cross Timbers Gazette’
- advertising our campaign and our UNT / LISD football event on
9/21 at DATCU stadium
- We will be doing more direct texting
- We recently launched Tik Tok and YouTube accounts to help reach voters
- In addition to ongoing Facebook, Instagram and X accounts
- We made improvements to our website

All of this to try to reach our 300,000 vote win number.
Of course, this is in addition to our block walking, phone banking,
postcards, events and more.
Digital is so important when you look at the scale. We only bought
10,000 postcards, 22,500 lit cards, 600 yard signs, and 50 T-shirts. We
need the digital to help ramp up the number of people who know that we are
their team. We are the ones that are going to look out for them,
regardless of party, gender, race, orientation, or other. Hopefully, after
seeing my name in a few places, more people will reach out to you and us
for those healthy, convincing conversations that reassure people that we
are for real. *When that opportunity comes your way, make it count*!

I’ve also been very busy working on questionnaires.
- League of Women Voters questionnaire for their voter info website and
publication
- Dallas Morning News questionnaire for voter info, which along with an
interview may result in an endorsement
- The Cross Timbers Gazette questionnaire for publication in their October
issue
- The I Voter questionnaire for voter info
- The Alliance for Retired Americans questionnaire

We have been distributing our supply of 500 new yard signs. We are so
grateful for all of the help in getting these out to good homes and
places. Signs aren’t the number one reason people vote for a candidate,
but it feels good to see your candidate’s signs out there. We have two
great volunteers who have stepped up to manage the overall sign plan for
polling places. They will be enlisting more volunteers to each cover a
smaller part of it. There will be about 50 early voting sites, and 120
polling locations for election day. That is too many for any one person to
manage. We’ll send out more contact information after we work out a few
details. Please consider volunteering to manage some signage for an area
near your home.

Just to say how important our volunteers truly are, we have done a lot on a
very low budget with your help! Through a shared vision of a Better
Future, we have all contributed and invested our time to make this campaign
fully viable in a way that most political watchers cannot understand. We
are still under the radar of most analysts for this reason. However, with
your help, we are on the radar of many voters and many more to come. Thank
You All!

A couple bigger / different events are coming up. These are special events
to support and interact with our community.

*Football Fun with Ernest Lineberger for US Congress on Saturday, September
21st at UNT DATCU stadium*.
There is a special promotion where half of the football admission
price goes to LISD LEF
(Lewisville Independent School District Educational
Foundation).
We will host a tailgate before the game where we can have our signs
and share our message.
We have rented a 10X20 tent with tables and chairs that will be
set up and waiting for us.
We need to decide on what food and fun we want to have at the
tailgate. (support appreciated)
During the game we can sit together in the end zone seating.
We bought 50 T-shirts to help us stand out.
If you have a light blue shirt, wear it to blend with us if we
run out.
Here is the link for tickets: https://fevo-enterprise.com/event/LEF
Game time is still TBA. I guessed 3 PM for tailgate start, but will
update when solidified.
Mobilize link is:
https://www.mobilize.us/dentondemocrats/event/673008/
But don’t forget to buy the tickets with the other
link too.

*CCA (Christian Community Action)* does a lot of good work in the community
with food pantry, job training, counseling and more. They are having
a *fundraising
5K on Saturday, September 28th, in Old Town Lewisville*. We are planning
to support by showing up as a team to run (or to support) in our
‘Lineberger’ T-shirts (or other light blue shirt).
Our special Team 5k Sign up link is:
*https://runsignup.com/Race/TX/Lewisville/hearts?raceRefCode=FcG0YSnd*
<https://runsignup.com/Race/TX/Lewisville/hearts?raceRefCode=FcG0YSnd>
This includes a price break and admission to City
of Lewisville Western Days
The mobilize link is:
https://www.mobilize.us/dentondemocrats/event/675364/
(just for RSVP, use the first link to sign up/pay
for the event)

If any of you want to play a role in any of these activities or efforts, I
can always use the help.

That said, I want to give a huge shout out to all of you who are already
working it! Thank you!
*Block Walkers* – We continue to have our Saturday morning
block walks with 10 or more working it with us.
Plus, several volunteers have asked for turf maps
to knock doors on their own schedule!
*Phone Bankers* – Our trained crew is working it on their own
schedule. Let us know if you want to join.
This is a great way to connect voters with our
message from the comfort of your home.
*Postcards* – We bought 10,000 and have handed out 8,200 to be
addressed and mailed so far.
Thank you so much for all you are doing to help in these
efforts!

With that in mind, here is what’s coming up soon.

*Sunday, Wednesday, Sept 8 – 11*, Ernest and Darlene trip to DC
This trip was planned before the campaign as just a fun event.
We will have a Capitol tour and try to schedule some time with
elected officials and others.

*Tuesday, Sept 10th*, Harris – Trump Presidential Debate,
DCDP has planned a watch party in Carrollton at NICO’s Cocina
3065 N Josey Ln
I can’t be there, but come by and support Denton County
Democratic Party and Kamala Harris.
https://www.mobilize.us/dentondemocrats/event/666489/

*Thursday, Sept 12th*, United Way Denton County, Breakfast in Lewisville, TX

*Saturday, Sept 14th*, Block Walking, 9 AM to 1030, Arrowbrooke with the
Dems of 380!
Meeting location in Aubry will be provided when you sign up
Link to RSVP and details:
https://www.mobilize.us/dentondemocrats/event/689401/

*Sunday, September 15th*, Visit another Church in district to better learn
our community

*Tuesday, Sept 17th*, 11 am, Political Lens – podcast, I think this is a
recording session to be played later

*Tuesday, Sept 17th*, Wise County Faith Hub of TP USA Faith, 5 PM
Aurora Baptist Church, 201 Derting Rd, Aurora, TX
This may be a chance to reach some who typically do not vote
for Dem’s

*Wednesday, Sept 18th*, 6:30 pm, Flower Mound Area Dem’s meeting with
Ernest speaking

*Saturday, September 21st*, Block Walking, 9 AM to Noon, Providence
Village, Precinct 1013
Meeting at 13125 North Haven Way, Providence Village, TX
Link to RSVP and details: TBD

*Saturday, September 21st*, UNT vs. Wyoming Football game and Tailgate to
benefit LISD LEF
Time is still TBD. Hopefully not too late or too early. Lots
of fun to be had.
Plan to come to be part of the sea of light blue shirts to help
spread our message.
See Links to sign up in earlier paragraph

*Sunday, September 22nd*, Visit another Church in district to better learn
our community

*Sunday, September 22nd*, 4:30 – 8:30 PM, Frisco Dems GOTV Rally
Nack Theater, 6711 Oak St, Frisco, TX The doors will open at
4:30 PM for a meet and greet with local candidates. The official start time
of the event is 5:00 PM. Delia Parker-Mims and Sheena King will both speak,
then candidates (me included) will be given a few minutes each to talk to
the audience. Our keynote speaker will be Texas State Representative James
Talarico!

To donate, just go to the regular donation link on the campaign website,
https://www.linebergerforuscongress.com/.

Everything you do to support us in our efforts to get our message out,
support our campaign financially, and your own personal efforts to share
our message are making a difference. Thank you!

Giving Voters a Better Choice and Hope for a Better Future!

Ernest Lineberger

Your Democratic Nominee for US House for TX CD26.

body:
We have outrageous news to share

| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=nv_update_9_7&n=1)
---
Peter, We have to be straight with you, we have outrageous news to share – the anti-Democratic Party has scored a major win against democracy in Nevada, where they have successfully denied the voters the choice to vote for the Green Party and our campaign for people, planet and peace.
---
[ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/ads?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=nv_update_9_7&n=2)
---
The Nevada Supreme Court struck a body-blow against democracy when they ruled 5-2 that the over 29,000 signatures submitted by the Nevada Green Party – almost three times the required number – were invalidated by a technicality. The fine print in the affidavits used by the petition circulators was incorrect – **_the same affidavits that the Democratic Secretary of State directed the Green Party to use for our petition effort!_****_
_****_
_**The anti-Democratic Party has wailed endlessly that they must win this election in order to “save democracy.” In reality, they have ruthlessly declared war on democracy, especially Jill and Butch’s anti-genocide, pro-worker, pro-planet campaign. From draining our resources to fight their onslaught of lawfare against our ballot access efforts, to posting jobs for operatives to manage infiltrators and spies to sabotage our campaign, to delaying our approved federal matching funds during a key moment in securing ballot access in many states, they’ve made clear that they’ll stop at nothing to limit voter choice to the duopoly parties of war and Wall Street. They’ll even exploit having officials in what are supposed to be neutral election administration roles act as saboteurs on their behalf.

The dirty Dems have managed to deny millions of voters in Nevada the choice to vote their values, but Jill and Butch aren’t going away, and they’ll never stop fighting for you.[

**_Peter_ _,__we need to get Jill and Butch’s campaign on the radar of voters all over the nation and let them know that they don’t have to cast their vote for genocide abroad and oligarchy at home. Can you donate today to make sure we can take out ads to spread their empowering vision far and wide - and show the dirty Dems their attacks on democracy aren’t going to stop us?_**](https://www.jillstein2024.com/ads?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=nv_update_9_7&n=3)

---
Together we can send a strong message that real democracy will prevail over the millions of dollars in dark money that they’ve poured into this no-holds-barred attack on voter choice that they’ve waged against us. Yes, they “won” the battle to deny voter choice in Nevada, but they’ll never stop the power of the people. With your support, Jill and Butch are poised to shock the world come November - and keep building real power for the people beyond Election Day!

In solidarity and gratitude, The Jill Stein/Butch Ware Team

name: Tamie Wilson
subject: Don’t ask if women are ready to lead
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/100067/images/LOGO.jpg]
Friends,
Last month, former First Lady Michelle Obama delivered a powerful message: "We cannot indulge our anxieties about whether this country will elect someone like Kamala instead of doing everything we can to get someone like Kamala elected."
That call to action couldn’t ring truer today, especially here in Ohio.
We can't waste time and precious energy wondering if voters are ready for a woman to represent this district. We've got to put in the work to get it done.
I’ve spent my life in this community. Born and raised in Ohio, I know firsthand what people and working families go through every day—the struggles, the triumphs, the fight to make ends meet.
But time and time again, I’ve been underestimated for no other reason than the fact that I’m a woman.
I know a lot of you have experienced this, too, or you've seen it happen to someone you love.
I’m accustomed to being the underdog. I am a woman, a minority woman at that, AND a single mother. Some men, like Jim Jordan, see someone like me and judge. They see weakness, rather than pure unadulterated strength and power, and that my friends is why I always beat men just like Jordan.
I’m short. I’m used to people looking over me and underestimating me. I laugh to myself and go around them and get things done. I fly under the radar and I am perfectly happy here. I have to admit it makes winning that much sweeter.
Women all over this country know exactly what I’m talking about. We have to work twice as hard, especially in the eyes of other women, unfortunately. We are underestimated, overlooked, and cast aside when it comes to leadership despite being the backbone of our homes, workplaces, and communities.
You don’t need to ask if we’re ready—WE’RE ALWAYS READY. Every dollar you contribute to our movement fuels our fight to defeat Jim Jordan and send me to Congress to fight for us, our families, our rights, and our future. Don’t wait for permission—join us in making history! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240907_we_are_ready_link1]
Let’s be clear: the ULTRA-MAGA extremists are doing everything they can to roll back women’s freedoms, from voting rights to body autonomy.
They want to control our choices, our futures, and our voices.
And leading the charge in this assault on women is none other than Jim Jordan.
Jordan has spent his entire career pushing extremist, anti-woman policies—whether it's co-sponsoring the National Right to Life Act to ban abortion nationwide or voting against laws that protect women from violence and discrimination.
He’s a proud supporter of efforts to defund Planned Parenthood, block access to affordable birth control, and strip away protections for survivors of domestic violence and sexual assault.
And it doesn’t stop there.
Jordan’s attacks on women extend far beyond our bodies—he’s also targeting our right to vote and participate in our democracy.
This is exactly why we need more women in office—women who will fight for our rights, our autonomy, and our place at the table.
We cannot let Jim Jordan and his ULTRA-MAGA cronies continue to dictate our futures.
I am a fighter. I work smart and hard. I am a winner. I’m running for Congress to ensure that women’s voices are not only heard but lead the way in creating a more just and equitable future. But to do that, I need your help.
Make a donation and join our movement today, and let’s show Jim Jordan and the extremists that their time is UP and we are taking the lead. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240907_we_are_ready_link2]
Working for US,
Tamie Wilson
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/100067/images/Screenshot%202023-08-30%20at%2012.16.45%20PM.jpeg]

Tamie Wilson is the Democratic nominee ready to unseat ULTRA MAGA extremist Jim Jordan in OH-04. A single mom and survivor who knows what it’s like to endure and overcome challenges, Tamie's fighting for jobs, healthcare, and positive change for everyday Americans. Your donations will help Tamie turn out every voter we need to flip this seat and send Jordan packing.

Derek — you can
hear the spitting anger and desperation from Donald Trump’s campaign in
their increasingly desperate attacks.

As they frantically search for something, anything they can tether to a
coherent campaign message with time running out until this election, they
picked a familiar target — yours truly.

“Shifty Schiff has no right to talk about morals, considering he’s one of
the most despicable and disgusting elected officials in Congress.”

All because I called Trump out on CNN for flip-flopping on the fundamental
right to abortion — no less than 4 times in 48 hours. His willingness to
change his stance every 15 minutes on a matter this serious shows that in
addition to opposing women’s reproductive freedoms, he has no moral
compass or values at all. He only believes in his own self-interest.

But as Trump’s spokesperson saw it, that wasn’t an indictment of their
candidate, but of those willing to confront him — the same old story for
Trump’s entire political career.

I’m used to the attacks from Trump personally,
Derek. And now, I need your help
to respond to his campaign flacks. Every time he and his team come after
me, their insults and lies multiply through their right-wing echo chambers
and risk having voters believe them.

official application through your local election administrator’s office**.

—The Power the Polls Team

P.P.S. Your local jurisdiction might call poll workers something different –
like “election workers” or “election judges” – but no matter the name, the
need for temporary employees to help elections run smoothly is real!

When it comes to Rick Scott, we couldn't have said it better:

Well, it's super off-putting how determined he is to control women's bodily autonomy and reproductive choices, going so far as to support a nationwide ban on abortions whether we like it or not.
It's really strange that he'd block the Right to IVF Act despite 70% of all voters being in favor of protecting this common fertility treatment.
But it's straight-up _nauseating_ that he spent millions on ads to pull the wool over our eyes and LIE about that same vote.
